entities.summary: Fatimatu Abubakar is a Ghanaian lawyer, politician and entrepreneur. She is a member of the New Patriotic Party and the current Minister for Information. Fatimatu Abubakar previously served as the Deputy Information Minister and was also the Deputy Communications Director at the Office of the President. Prior to her political appointments, she worked at the Lansdown Resort, Aburi, and SRM Engineering Limited, where she served as a house manager and a Clerk respectively. She studied Psychology and English for her first and second degrees.
